label: Diagram 2.19
caption: Diagram 2.19 Wall types 2.1 and 2.2 | – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf | E VERSION | E
description:
The drawing is a plan view, with the word "PLAN" printed in the lower right corner of the framed area. Above the frame a green title band reads "Diagram 2.19 Wall types 2.1 and 2.2 – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf".

Within the frame two masonry walls are drawn as parallel vertical bands of hatched blocks, one on the left and one on the right, separated by an open gap representing the cavity. The left wall shows a small grey-shaded square at its mid-height. Two horizontal rectangular members, hatched with a diagonal pattern, project inward from the right-hand wall into the cavity, one above and one below the mid-point, without reaching the left wall. A thin leader line runs from the grey-shaded square down and to the right, ending at the label "Cavity stop". No other dimensions or symbols are shown.
